[assistant] - [High] .claude/settings.local.json:40 — Allows `codex exec -s danger-full-access ...`, which grants unrestricted filesystem/network-capable execution and bypasses the configured safety boundary.
- [High] .claude/settings.local.json:43 — `Bash(codex exec *)` broadly permits arbitrary nested Codex execution, making the more specific deny/allow policy easy to bypass.
- [Medium] core/hooks/skill_self_evolution.py:164 — `_current_run_id` is never initialized in this hook, so all skill evolution events fall back to `runs/_skill_evolution/events.jsonl` and lose per-run attribution.
